content.caseIdentity: Rylands v. Fletcher, L.R. 3 H.L. 330 (House of Lords)
content.holding: A person who brings and keeps on his land anything likely to do mischief if it escapes is prima facie answerable for all damage that is the natural consequence of its escape, even in the absence of personal negligence.
content.relevance: Established the common law doctrine of Strict Liability for non-natural user of land.
